    def bfs(graph, start):
        visited = set()
        queue = deque([start])
        visited.add(start)
        result = [start]
        while queue:
            current = queue.popleft()
            for neighbor in sorted(graph[current]):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append(neighbor)
                    result.append(neighbor)
        return result
